messages:
Morgan: Heads-up — I'm kicking off the orders schema migration (orders.schema_v2) in ~15m. Deploybot will run a small canary (5% traffic) then ramp. Watch for lock warnings and read-replica lag.

Shiv: ack. which tables/backfill? any long-running updates?

Morgan: backfill: orders.metadata JSONB -> new columns; small per-row UPDATE in batches (batch_size=500). No FK changes. Will set statement_timeout=5s for the backfill process.

Elaine: please pin API version to 2026-03-21-v2 on canary so consumers don't pick up new shape until late rollout.

Morgan: will pin. deploying canary with env:
```
DEPLOY_TAG=orders-schema-v2-canary
BACKFILL_BATCH=500
SET statement_timeout=5000
```

deploybot: Deploy queued by Morgan. Steps:
1) run schema rollout on replica0
2) migrate read-only indexes
3) run canary migration on 5% traffic
4) run backfill job with rate limit 100/s
5) promote schema

Carter: watchpoints? if p99 latency > 200ms or replica lag > 30s abort.

Shiv: +1. add rollback criteria: abort if >10% errors or p99 increase >2x for 5m.

ops-sre: also monitor db locks: if any lock held > 10s by backfill, kill job and pause; we should have an escape hatch: `./scripts/kill-backfill --tag orders-schema-v2`

Morgan: noted. I'll set a canary holdpoint at 20m after start. If metrics breach before, manual rollback. Will ping #eng-oncall and #product-release.

Elaine: if we need to rollback, what's data plan for partially-applied backfill? can backfill be resumed idempotently?

Morgan: yes, backfill is idempotent (it uses `WHERE new_col IS NULL`). rollback just drops the new columns added in migration step 1 if we fail after canary. But if we promote, backfill continues safely.

deploybot: Canary started (5% traffic). Logs: https://deploys/redwood/orders-schema-v2/canary

Shiv: checking dashboards — p99 healthy at 95ms, errors steady. :thumbsup:

ops-sre: replica lag at 6s, backfill threads 3/5, avg lock time 0.3s.

Morgan: continuing to ramp to 25% in 10m unless objections.

Carter: no objections. I'll be on watch for lock anomalies.

Elaine: pinning API for canary now.

Morgan: thanks — will update thread if anything changes. I'll post final promote note when at 100%.
